designGate.prompt: Before coding, sketch how you will call their chunk API and what state you will track so a later 'never underrun' policy can choose quality without rewriting fetch. Name the buffer quantity.

parts.title: Max quality playback

hints.text: qualities() is ordered low to high. Which index is max?
Player only stores the api; play_max_quality is a simple loop.

probes: Why inject the API instead of hard-coding fetch?

parts.title: Never underrun

hints.text: What does buffered mean after you finish downloading a chunk but before the next decision?
Startup: fetch chunk 0 at max quality with no check. Then buffered = media(0). For later chunks, highest q with estimate(q,i) <= buffered.
After pick: buffered -= estimate; buffered += media(i). If no q fits, ValueError.

probes: What do you do if even low quality estimates above buffered?

parts.title: Smooth quality steps

hints.text: Track the previous quality's index in the ladder.
Candidate qualities must also satisfy |idx - prev| <= max_step (except chunk 0).
Reuse the underrun loop; filter by step, then pick highest remaining.

probes: Why limit step size if underrun already forces drops?
How would you adapt if estimate_fetch_seconds is noisy?
